seal a deal: After weeks of talks, the two companies finally shook hands to seal a deal worth ten million dollars.
經過數週的談判，兩家公司終於握手敲定交易，金額達一千萬美元。
seal one's fate: The other team's late goal sealed their fate, and they were sent down to a lower league next season.
對手在最後關頭的進球決定了他們的命運，他們下一季被降到較低的聯盟。
seal the envelope: Before you seal the envelope, check that you have put the letter and the photo inside it.
在封信之前，先確認你已經把信和照片放進信封裡了。
seal off the area: After a gas leak, police usually seal off the area and tell everyone to stay away from the building.
瓦斯外洩後，警方通常會封鎖區域，並要求所有人遠離那棟大樓。
seal the victory: With only two minutes left, her third goal helped seal the victory for our school team.
比賽只剩兩分鐘時，她的第三個進球幫我們校隊鎖定勝局。
seal one's lips: I promised my sister I would seal my lips and never tell Mom about her secret boyfriend.
我答應姊姊會守口如瓶，絕不把她祕密男友的事告訴媽媽。
search for the truth: The reporter spent three years searching for the truth in old police files and secret government documents.
這名記者花了三年在舊的警方檔案和政府機密文件中追尋真相。
search one's heart: Before you decide to quit school, you should search your heart and ask what you really want.
在決定休學之前，你應該捫心自問，自己真正想要的是什麼。
search the house: The police searched the house for hours but could not find the missing jewelry anywhere.
警方搜索房子好幾個小時，卻到處都找不到遺失的珠寶。
search me: When I asked my brother where the TV remote was, he just shrugged and said, "Search me."
我問哥哥電視遙控器在哪裡，他只是聳聳肩說：「我哪知道。」
in search of: Every winter, thousands of birds fly south in search of warmer weather and more food.
每年冬天，成千上萬的鳥飛往南方，尋找較溫暖的天氣和更多食物。
season the soup: Taste it first, and then season the soup with a little salt and black pepper.
先嚐一口，再用一點鹽和黑胡椒為湯調味。
a seasoned traveler: As a seasoned traveler who has visited forty countries, my uncle always knows how to pack light.
身為一位去過四十個國家的老練的旅人，我叔叔總是知道怎麼輕裝出行。
season wood: You should season wood for at least six months so that it is dry enough to burn well.
你應該將木材風乾至少六個月，讓它夠乾才好燒。
in season: Strawberries are cheap and sweet when they are in season, so my mom buys a lot in spring.
草莓當季時又便宜又甜，所以我媽媽春天會買很多。
secure a victory: A late goal in the final minute helped the team secure a victory over their old rivals.
最後一分鐘的進球幫助球隊確保勝利，擊敗了他們的老對手。
secure a loan: To open her own café, she had to secure a loan from the bank first.
為了開自己的咖啡店，她得先向銀行取得貸款。
secure a job: After graduating, he worked hard to secure a job at a large technology company in Taipei.
畢業後，他努力爭取，希望在台北的大型科技公司獲得工作。
secure the border: The government sent more soldiers to secure the border after the conflict broke out next door.
鄰國爆發衝突後，政府派更多士兵守住邊界。
secure the future: Planting more trees today is one way to help secure the future for our children and grandchildren.
今天多種樹，是為我們的子孫保障未來的方法之一。
secure a contract: Our company finally secured a contract to build the new bridge after months of hard negotiation.
經過數月的艱苦談判，我們公司終於拿下合約，負責興建新的橋。
feel secure: Children feel secure when their parents give them a warm home and clear rules.
當父母給孩子溫暖的家和清楚的規矩時，孩子會有安全感。
seed the clouds: During the long drought, scientists tried to seed the clouds with special chemicals to make it rain.
在長期乾旱期間，科學家嘗試用特殊化學物質對雲層進行人工造雨。
seed a tournament: Organizers usually seed a tournament so that the two best players cannot meet until the final.
主辦單位通常會為錦標賽安排種子選手，讓兩位最強的選手直到決賽才會碰頭。
seeded players: The top seeded players do not have to play in the first round of the tennis tournament.
頭號種子選手不必在網球錦標賽的第一輪出賽。
sow the seeds of: Unfair treatment of workers can sow the seeds of anger and lead to serious protests later.
不公平對待勞工可能播下憤怒的種子，日後引發嚴重的抗議。
go to seed: After the factory closed, the small town began to go to seed, with empty shops everywhere.
工廠關閉後，這個小鎮開始衰敗，到處都是空蕩蕩的商店。
seize the opportunity: When the teacher asked for volunteers to study abroad, Amy seized the opportunity right away.
老師徵求出國進修的志願者時，Amy 馬上把握機會。
seize power: The angry generals sent tanks into the capital and tried to seize power from the president by force.
憤怒的將軍們派坦克進入首都，企圖以武力從總統手中奪權。
seize the day: Don't wait for the perfect time to start your dream; seize the day and take the first step now.
別等完美的時機才開始追夢；把握今天，現在就踏出第一步。
seize control: The rebels tried to seize control of the radio station so they could spread their message.
叛軍企圖奪取控制權、掌握電台，以便散播他們的訊息。
seize property: The court ordered officials to seize property belonging to the businessman who refused to pay his taxes.
法院下令官員沒收財產，對象是那名拒絕繳稅的商人。
be seized with panic: When the fire alarm rang at midnight, the guests were seized with panic and ran toward the doors.
半夜火災警報響起時，房客們驚慌失措，衝向門口。
seize the moment: The shy boy finally seized the moment and asked her to dance before the music ended.
那個害羞的男孩終於把握當下，在音樂結束前邀她跳舞。
